long_biography.plain_text:
Born and educated in Bristol, Bailey spent fifteen years leading his family's Independent Car Auctions. His satellite-auction concept, AuctionVision, prompted a 1996 approach to Manheim in the United States. The resulting joint venture combined ICA with Central Motor Auctions, and subsequent acquisitions expanded the business to seventeen UK sites before it adopted the Manheim name.

Bailey continued broadening the company beyond physical auctions. Successive businesses added inspection, vehicle services, digital auctions and dealer software, while his international remit grew across Europe, Australia and Canada. He left Cox in 2018 after four decades in automotive auctions and remarketing.
